purpose: CodeBlock 代码高亮; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority: [IslandCodeBlock](../../lib/src/components/code_block.dart), [IslandCodeBlockStyle](../../lib/src/components/code_block.dart), [IslandCodeBlockTheme](../../lib/src/components/code_block.dart), [IslandCodeToken](../../lib/src/components/code_block.dart) and the explicit public root. This contract owns styling support/precedence; signatures/defaults are not duplicated here.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Controlled values are authoritative. Component owns only focus, hover, preview, motion and explicitly uncontrolled state.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required.
interface.localization: The copy button text (复制/已复制/复制失败, Copy/Copied/Copy failed) and names come from IslandLocalizations; code is the host's and stays left-to-right.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: CodeBlock owns one resolved recipe and one lexer/render path. IslandCodeBlockStyle is shared by the instance and IslandCodeBlockTheme.style. For each non-null backgroundColor/foregroundColor/borderColor and each syntaxColors entry: instance > scoped theme > the unchanged default deep-brown recipe. Null means fallback; explicit transparent colors are values, not null. The seven IslandCodeToken roles are comment, literal (string/number/shell argument), command, keyword, type, function and punctuation; unclassified source uses foregroundColor. Shell `//` comment spans are italic at weight 400 in the resolved comment colour (reference highlightShell); shell `#` comments and Dart and JavaScript comments stay upright (reference Skill page and highlightJSX). The bundled Fira Code has no italic face, so the engine slants it; pitch and the forced 1.7 line box are unchanged. Shell additionally classifies `#` comments (line start or after whitespace), tree connectors and -x/--flag options as punctuation, file names with a known extension as type, `~/` paths as literal, and keeps hyphenated words and other paths whole in foregroundColor. Lexer classification is unchanged and applies resolved role colors while creating spans; no second lexer or traversal/rewrite of generated or opaque spans. textStyle attributes merge default > theme > instance; resolved foregroundColor replaces textStyle.color for base Color ink. An explicit textStyle.foreground Paint retains Flutter precedence over Color, including span colors; it is opaque caller paint, not a generated semantic Color role. Advanced Paint/shader pairing is outside this bounded Color-role guarantee and is not normalized or inferred. Default family is the packaged IslandTheme.codeFontFamily with zero letter spacing and inherited fallback. Copy foreground/background/border use WidgetStateProperty per current state, instance non-null resolved value > theme non-null resolved value > recipe. The existing ActionSurface supplies hover/pressed/focused/disabled and the existing copy status adds WidgetState.error after failure; state flags coexist and no second lifecycle/state machine exists. Copy focus border, error foreground and hover/press backing may resolve independently. Reference copy motion: hover (not pressed) lifts the pill 1px over 250ms cubic(.4,0,.2,1), colours switch without interpolation and reduced motion settles immediately; keyboard focus paints a 2px ring 2px outside the pill in the focused copyBorderColor (recipe #19c8b9) while the recipe border keeps its resting colour. Theme recipes switch atomically through the ThemeExtension, not separate color interpolation. Explicit layout padding/radius/margin retain their existing owners; padding null retains the copy-action reserve. Content padding, explicit or the copy-action reserve, lies inside the horizontal scroll region as the reference `<pre>` padding: resting code runs under the copy button to the block edge and the reserve shows only at the scroll end. Callers own custom color pair choices and actual alpha/backing validation at4.5 text/3 necessary graphics; no silent inference or recoloring. Screen-reader execution remains excluded; semantic names and keyboard/copy lifecycle remain required. Default margin is the reference 1em (16px) vertical. Code lines use a forced strut from the resolved text style (reference line-height 1.7, 14px: one line box per line whatever the fallback runs). Inside a light IslandCursor arrow scope (ambient selection colour equals the Cursor #e9c46a highlight) the selected range is painted in the reference selected ink #2b2620 (CodeBlockColors.selectedInk) over the highlight, as `.animal-cursor ::selection { color }`; unselected code, other selection colours and an explicit textStyle.foreground Paint keep their inks. The selected-ink pass reads the SelectableText's own render text and selection boxes; the code span and selection are not rebuilt.
interface.migration: One atomic pre-release migration: backgroundColor and textStyle move into style: IslandCodeBlockStyle(...); textStyle.color moves to style.foregroundColor, typography to style.textStyle. Highlighted roles use syntaxColors; copy roles are configured separately in the same style. All maintained consumers migrate together; no aliases, forwarding legacy inputs or alternate lexer.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.

scenarios.when: A child acts or a parent rebuilds/reorders/rejects a proposal
scenarios.then: No event bubbling, style overwrite, selection-index substitution or ownership violation.

scenarios.given: Every supported language and owned token role on the default deep-brown surface in both host themes
scenarios.when: Render comments, strings, numbers, keywords, types, calls, punctuation and plain source
scenarios.then: Every necessary code token meets4.5; custom background/style remains explicit consumer responsibility. Copy state labels retain their own readable backing.

scenarios.given: A complete light or dark syntax/surface/copy recipe, partial scoped and instance overrides, and actual alpha backing
scenarios.when: Render every language without changing source/language to evade highlighting, override one token or copy state, focus/hover/press/fail copy and interrupt theme transitions
scenarios.then: All seven token roles and unclassified source use the one resolved recipe; null falls back, transparent remains explicit; copy error and focus coexist. Required text4.5 and graphics3 are checked on actual supported backing. Source, font/selection state and clipboard lifecycle are retained.
